title: Humility
paragraphs: “Wow! That looks like fun!”
“What a wonderful sound.”
“Kou wants to sing too!”

The Filolials took an interest in Itsuki’s performance and approached the musicians. While playing, Itsuki glanced at the Filolials and smiled, then began playing a song that looped several times. At first, the Filolials listened quietly, but before long, they all started humming along. Gradually, their voices harmonized with Itsuki’s playing, and their beautiful voices combined to form an orchestra. I could feel the surrounding magic being activated.
“Come to think of it, isn’t magic cast by multiple people called chorus magic?”
“Maybe that’s where the term originated. If Itsuki, the Filolials, and the musicians all cast magic together right now, an incredible spell might be unleashed.”
Due to the activation of magic, radiant particles sparkled from the dragon veins in the surroundings.
“The dragon veins are shining!”
“So beautiful…”
“The sound is amazing too. I was used to synthesized sound, but hearing a live performance is a whole different experience.”
“Since coming to this world, I’ve heard a lot of live performances and singing in taverns, but Itsuki’s performance surpasses all of them.”

Everyone around was captivated by Itsuki’s music to that extent. As the piece neared its end, Itsuki executed an intricate movement of his fingers, something that could only be described as superlative technique, and finished by striking the violin-like instrument with great force. At first, everyone was silent, but soon, thunderous applause erupted. After returning the instrument to the musicians, Itsuki came back to us.
“Are you done eating?”
“No… I was so absorbed in your performance, Itsuki…”
“You don’t have to flatter me by saying you were captivated by something like my performance.”
“No, no, Itsuki, were you always this good at playing instruments?”
“What are you talking about?”
I recognize this reaction. Ren, perhaps realizing something, glared at Father.
“An unconscious talent outside of combat… this is definitely the same as Naofumi’s cooking!”
“Maybe it’s one of those things you don’t realize until someone points it out. Itsuki, can you replicate a song after hearing it just once?”
“Why are you surprised by something so simple?”
Itsuki answered as if it were the most natural thing. Could it be…?
“No way! That’s not normal! Ah, damn it! I thought you were one of us, Itsuki, but I was wrong!”
“I don’t understand why Ren-san is angry…”
“That was so much fun!”
“Indeed!”
“Let’s sing again!”
The Filolials cheerfully called out to Itsuki.
“Hey, Itsuki, could it be that you have a talent for music?”
“I’ve never heard anything like that… Ah, well, I used to do it a bit as a hobby.”
“Just admit it’s on the same level as Naofumi’s cooking.”

Ren’s resentful gaze is quite noticeable. What about me, though? Do I have any obvious talents? I do wonder, but saying anything to Ren right now would just make things worse, and Father would probably scold me, so I’ll keep quiet.
“Itsuki, that talent for playing instruments… could it be on the level of an innate ability?”
“No, no, talent and innate abilities are different. You all wouldn’t know this, but even a low-ranked ability related to sound wouldn’t be at this level.”
Itsuki answered with an unusually humble tone, almost unnaturally so.
“Besides, innate abilities are evaluated based on that specific skill. Even if I had the talent you’re talking about, it wouldn’t be recognized by my innate ability.”

I’m sure I wasn’t the only one slightly irritated by Itsuki’s calm response. It’s that strange humility. It’s completely unlike the Itsuki I know. Why is he so modest only when it comes to his own talents? I just can’t understand it. Having ability is far better. It’s better than being like me, with nothing but my looks!
“Well, since everyone insists, should I start flaunting my skills like Naofumi-san? I guess that puts me one step ahead.”
Itsuki flashed a fearless smile at me and Ren. That’s the look, isn’t it? The look of someone who’s found a way to get ahead after feeling like he was losing to Father while heading to Faubrey.
“If we use it well, the power of magic will increase! And with the activation of the dragon veins, the monsters will get stronger, but we’ll gain tons of experience!” Rival also cheerfully responded.
She’s completely attached to Itsuki now.
“Then Itsuki, whenever we’re leveling up the party, you’ll be playing music the whole time. Ride the Filolials, shoot while playing an instrument.”
“What kind of Western is that?”
“Then I’ll go get a rope.”
“Why would you do that!? Besides, there’s no way I can play in that situation!”
Well, Ren and Itsuki kept arguing like that until we returned to our rooms after finishing the meal.
“Alright, Gaelion-chan, go rest in the dragon stable.”
Father returned to the bedroom and was about to take Rival and Assistant to the dragon stable outside. However, Rival complained with dissatisfaction.
“Why does Gaelion have to sleep in the dragon stable alone?!”
Rival throws a tantrum every time. Each time, Father waits in the dragon stable until Rival falls asleep.
“Don’t be so selfish, Gaelion. I’ll sleep with you, so bear with it.”
“Ugh… But before that, I’ll show Naofumi and the others the magic I worked hard to learn recently!”
Saying that, Rival spread her wings wide and began chanting some kind of magic. Soon, she was enveloped in a glowing cocoon of light.
“Huh? W-What is she trying to do?”
“Energetic even though it’s already late…”
“Indeed.”
“It’s getting noisy. What’s going on?”
Éclair, who had been standing guard outside the room, entered after hearing the commotion. She rushes in if there’s any trouble. A commendable sense of duty as a knight.
“Well, you see, Gaelion-chan is being fussy… and now it looks like she’s trying to do something.”
“Miss Wyndia, can’t you do something?”
“I’m trying, but…”
Assistant was clearly at a loss. As for Mole, it was pacing back and forth nervously on the bed. Yuki-chan and the other Filolials were watching the scene with narrowed eyes.
“Motoyasu-sama! Gaelion’s done something!”
“Shall I take her down?”
“Why does your mind immediately go to such violent measures? Anyway, Yuki-chan, do you know what Gaelion-chan is doing?”
“Sakura knows too!”
“Then, what is she doing?”
Was it just as Father was asking Sakura-chan?
“Nano!”

Rival burst out of the glowing cocoon. Standing there was… a child with dragon wings, about the same height as Sakura-chan. Her hair was long and red. For some reason, the way it flowed gave the impression of a tail. Such long hair. Her facial features, though frustrating to admit, were on par with the Filolials. With the shape of her wings resembling those of a demon, should she be called a demon child?
“I did it, Naofumi! Gaelion can transform using humanization magic now!”
Rival spun around cheerfully, showing off. Assistant pointed at her, opening and closing his mouth several times, clearly at a loss for words. Father, Ren, and Itsuki didn’t seem too surprised.
“Well, considering Yuki-san and the others as precedents, and the fact that Takt’s Dragon Emperor was able to take human form, it’s not unimaginable.”
“Yeah, something like this isn’t surprising anymore.”
“Still… why a little girl?”
“Sis, how do I look? With this form, do you think I can charm Naofumi? Nano!”

Rival struck a mysterious seductive pose and asked Assistant. Assistant’s expression was one of complete disbelief, either because it was beyond comprehension or because she was simply too dumbfounded.
